content.text: The document expressly disclaims any non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer; the only competitive restraint binds Vendor.

input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Clause 12.3 expressly confirms that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, or conducting business in any field or territory, and records that Customer has given no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. Section 2.1 reinforces this (no minimum quantity or purchase commitment). The only competitive restraint in the document, clause 12.4, binds Vendor not to develop or market a service competing with Customer's analytics products during the term, which benefits us and is not flagged. The reverse-engineering and acceptable-use limits in 13.4 are ordinary licence-use restrictions, not field-of-use or non-compete restraints on our business. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.
